Engineer audio systems and integrated technology platforms that augment the driving experience Combine ingenuity, in-depth research, and a spirit of collaboration with design and engineering excellence Advance in-vehicle infotainment, safety, efficiency, and enjoyment What You’ll Be Part Of In this role, you will be responsible for a fleet of prototype vehicles used for UX validation, feature testing, and customer demonstrations. These vehicles are critical for assessing both the market readiness of individual components and the overall user experience, ensuring that all systems come together seamlessly from a customer perspective. You will coordinate the integration and build of these vehicles across global locations in Europe, the United States, and Asia, ensuring smooth collaboration and consistent results. By defining and maintaining clear processes, you will help ensure that all builds meet high standards and accurately reflect intended production quality. You will provide technical leadership to a dedicated global team. This role combines coordination and a strong understanding of vehicle development to deliver high-quality prototype vehicles that enable both technical validation and a compelling end-to-end customer experience. How You’ll Make An Impact Lead the electrical and mechanical integration of infotainment and car audio systems in a global low-volume vehicle program (up to15 vehicles). Plan and coordinate vehicle builds, resources, and activities across Europe, the US, and Asia. Define and enforce standardized integration and build processes across all locations.. Ensure consistent, production-representative vehicles build globally. Integrate automotive components (HMI, displays, cameras, HUD, head units, audio systems). Align interfaces, wiring concepts, packaging, and mounting solutions.. Provide technical leadership to global engineering and build teams. Oversee suppliers and partners to ensure quality, consistency, and maturity. Act as key interface between engineering, vehicle integration, project management, and leadership. Communicate status, risks, and deviations transparently. What Makes You A Strong Fit Bachelor’s degree in engineering, science, or other relevant related fields. 7+ years of firsthand automotive delivery experience. Proven track record within the use of project management methodologies. Technical background and documented hands-on experience from R&D projects. Excellent communication skills both in written and spoken English and German. Experience from working in the fuzzy innovative front-end of product definition and creation of early demonstrators. Ability to work closely together with internal and external partners, vendors, team members, and stakeholders. Ability to provide technical leadership and motivate dedicated teams involving cross-functional team members and global stakeholders. Financial stolidity, to stay within defined project budgets and to secure strong business cases. We see AI as an important part of how work gets done. While tools may vary, a baseline familiarity with using AI to support efficiency, problem-solving, and quality is expected. Things To Know Be willing to travel up to 20% of domestic and international travel. This position requires the use of a HARMAN or customer-owned vehicle. As such, any offer of employment will be contingent upon having a clean driving record, which will be evaluated and determined at HARMAN’s sole discretion, no more than 4 active points for moving violations (issued by any motor vehicle agency), and no references to operating a vehicle under the influence of controlled substances within the last 10 years. What You Can Expect A hybrid work environment that balances flexibility with in-person collaboration, with most office-based roles onsite three days a week. Access to employee discounts on world-class HARMAN and Samsung products (JBL, Harman Kardon, AKG and others). Learning and development opportunities through our award-winning HARMAN University programs An inclusive and diverse work environment that fosters and encourages professional and personal development Work on best-in-class emerging technologies and an atmosphere that motivates you to give your best. You Belong Here HARMAN is committed to making every employee feel welcomed, valued, and empowered. No matter what role you play, we encourage you to share your ideas, voice your distinct perspective, and bring your whole self with you – all within a support-minded culture that celebrates what makes each of us unique. We also recognize that learning is a lifelong pursuit and want you to flourish. We proudly offer added opportunities for training, development, and continuing education, further empowering you to live the career you want. About HARMAN: Where Innovation Unleashes Next-Level Technology Ever since the 1920s, we’ve been amplifying the sense of sound. Today, that legacy endures, with integrated technology platforms that make the world smarter, safer, and more connected. Across automotive, lifestyle, and digital transformation solutions, we create innovative technologies that turn ordinary moments into extraordinary experiences. Our renowned automotive and lifestyle solutions can be found everywhere, from the music we play in our cars and homes to venues that feature today’s most sought-after performers, while our digital transformation solutions serve humanity by addressing the world’s ever-evolving needs and demands. Marketing our award-winning portfolio under 16 iconic brands, such as JBL, Mark Levinson, and Revel, we set ourselves apart by exceeding the highest engineering and design standards for our customers, our partners and each other. If you’re ready to innovate and do work that makes a lasting impact, join our talent community today! Important Notice: Recruitment Scams Please be aware that HARMAN recruiters will always communicate with you from an '@harman.com', ‘@careers.harman.com’ or ‘harmanglobal.avature.net’ email address. We will never ask for payments, banking, credit card, personal financial information or access to your LinkedIn/email account during the screening, interview, or recruitment process. If you are asked for such information or receive communication from an email address not ending in one of the above email domains about a job with HARMAN, please cease communication immediately and report the incident to us through: harmancareers@harman.com. HARMAN is proud to be an Equal Opportunity employer. HARMAN strives to hire the best qualified candidates and is committed to building a workforce representative of the diverse marketplaces and communities of our global colleagues and customers. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. HARMAN attracts, hires, and develops employees based on merit, qualifications and job-related performance.(www.harman.com)

review_candidates.title: Director of Customer Success
review_candidates.description: Ellipsis Health is redefining how care teams engage and support patients through voice-based artificial intelligence. Our Voice AI Care Manager, Sage, delivers empathetic, real-time conversations that help health plans and care management teams scale outreach, reduce operational bottlenecks, and improve member experience and outcomes. Built on a foundation of more than 3 million real clinical conversations, Ellipsis Health’s proprietary vocal biomarker technology enables Sage to understand not just what is said—but how it is said—bringing emotional intelligence into care at scale. Today, Ellipsis Health partners with leading health plans, PBMs, provider, pharma, care management organizations, and healthcare innovators to support engagement across a variety of care management and patient engagement use cases. Backed by top investors including CVS Health/Aetna, Salesforce Ventures, and Khosla Ventures, Ellipsis Health is entering its next phase of growth—expanding market presence, deepening enterprise partnerships, and defining the category for empathetic voice AI in healthcare. About The Team The Customer Success team is responsible for turning customer commitments into realized value. We sit at the center of the post-sales lifecycle — partnering with Commercial, Product, Engineering, and Operations to ensure every deployment is successful, measurable, and expandable. Our work begins once a deal is signed but doesn’t end at go-live. We lead customers through onboarding, integration, adoption, optimization, and expansion, translating customer goals into structured execution plans and ensuring Ellipsis’ AI becomes embedded in real clinical and operational workflows. As the company scales, the team’s role is evolving from delivering individual successful projects to building a repeatable operating model for enterprise healthcare deployments. We operate as both operators and architects: directly supporting key customer engagements while also building the playbooks, success metrics, and operating rhythms that allow the organization to grow predictably. By creating clarity across teams and accountability across the lifecycle, the team ensures Ellipsis delivers durable outcomes — not just successful launches. About The Role We’re hiring a Director, Customer Success to own the post-sales lifecycle and define how Sage — our conversational AI care manager — is successfully deployed and scaled across enterprise healthcare organizations. In this role, you will lead customers through the transition from contract to operational reality. You will be responsible for ensuring that Sage, our autonomous voice AI assistant, becomes embedded in real clinical and operational workflows — not just launched, but adopted, measured, and expanded. This is not a traditional Customer Success role focused solely on relationship management. You will partner closely with Product to oversee complex deployments of agentic AI into health plans and provider organizations, coordinating integrations, stakeholder alignment, regulatory considerations, and measurable outcomes. You will define what “great implementation” looks like in a category that is still being created. You will operate at the intersection of Commercial, Product, Engineering, and Operations — ensuring that what is sold can be delivered predictably, that what is delivered drives measurable value, and that successful deployments translate into durable retention and expansion. This is a rare opportunity to shape how AI is operationalized in one of the most complex industries in the world. Your work will directly influence how care teams function, how patients experience engagement, and how autonomous systems are responsibly integrated into healthcare environments. This is a remote US-based role with occasional travel for key customer engagements. Who We’re Looking For We’re looking for an operator who is equally comfortable running complex customer engagements and building the structure behind them. You know how to take a signed contract and turn it into a successful deployment, measurable outcomes, and a clear path to expansion. You bring strong judgment in ambiguous environments, communicate clearly with both customers and internal teams, and use data to guide decisions rather than react to noise. You should enjoy working cross-functionally — aligning Sales, Product, Engineering, and Operations around what it actually takes to deliver value in the real world. You’re willing to be hands-on where needed, but your goal is to make the next deployment easier than the last by creating repeatable processes and clear ownership. What You’ll Own Implementation Delivery: Support end-to-end deployments across enterprise healthcare customers, ensuring integrations, stakeholder alignment, and go-live readiness are predictable and successful. Customer Value & Retention: Drive adoption and outcomes across accounts, ensuring customers achieve measurable operational and clinical value and renew successfully. Expansion Strategy: Develop and operationalize the land-and-expand motion across use cases, business units, and stakeholders within customer organizations. Customer Lifecycle Operations: Establish health scoring, lifecycle reporting, renewal forecasting, and account segmentation to create proactive visibility into risk and opportunity. Sales-to-Delivery Alignment: Partner with Commercial to ensure deals are structured for successful implementation and smooth handoffs into delivery. Product Feedback & Prioritization: Translate real-world deployment learnings into structured feedback that informs product roadmap and implementation feasibility. Team & Playbook Development: Build the processes, documentation, and team structure required to scale Implementation and Customer Success as the company grows. What Success Looks Like (6-9 Months) Deployments launch on predictable timelines with clear internal ownership and customer accountability Customer value is measurable and communicated through standardized reporting and QBRs Retention risk is identified early and managed proactively Expansion becomes a repeatable motion rather than an opportunistic one Sales-to-delivery handoffs are structured and aligned to implementation capacity Implementation and Customer Success playbooks exist and support onboarding new team members Leadership has clear visibility into adoption, retention, and expansion performance Requirements Enterprise Customer Delivery Experience: 8+ years leading customer success, implementation, or delivery for complex enterprise SaaS or health technology customers Healthcare Environment Familiarity: Experience working with health plans, risk-bearing providers, MSOs, or regulated healthcare workflows involving PHI/HIPAA considerations and keen understanding of care management operations, workflows, and strategies. Stakeholder Management: Proven ability to manage multi-threaded relationships across executives, clinical leaders, operational teams, and technical stakeholders Operational Process Building: Track record of turning ambiguous deployment environments into standardized workflows, playbooks, and repeatable processes Adoption & Retention Ownership: Experience driving measurable adoption, renewal outcomes, and expansion within existing accounts Cross-Functional Leadership: Demonstrated success coordinating work across Sales, Product, Engineering, and Operations to deliver customer outcomes Analytical Decision-Making: Comfort using metrics and data to diagnose risk, prioritize work, and communicate performance to leadership and customers Technical Fluency: Working understanding of APIs, integrations, data flows, and technical implementation concepts without needing to code Builder Mindset: Experience operating in fast-growing environments where roles and processes evolve and require hands-on problem solving Salary And Benefits We offer competitive salary ($150k-$190k) and benefits, including 401(k) matching up to 4% percentage of your salary, health, vision, and dental insurance, and flexible paid time off. The amount offered will be determined by a variety of factors, including, but not limited to, your individual skills, qualifications, and past experience relative to the requirements of the role. Background Checks As a health technology company, we reserve the right to run a background check on any applicant to which we extend an offer and to re-perform any such check at any time during the course of employment. Please note that there is no set policy for rejecting candidates based on specific background check results, and we consider each candidate as a whole before making any decisions. We comply with all “ban the box” laws in applicable jurisdictions. Assistance If you have a disability or otherwise require any assistance whatsoever in the application or recruitment process, please feel free to submit a request to careers@ellipsishealth.com.
